title: German Chicken Wings for Afternoon Tea
description: A delicious and easy-to-make German-inspired chicken wings recipe perfect for a British afternoon tea.

ingredients.name: delicate british ale
ingredients.notes: or substitute with your favorite beer

instructions: 2. In a large bowl, mix together ale, mustard, brown sugar, salt, and black pepper.
3. Add the chicken wings to the bowl and toss to coat.
4. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and spray with cooking spray.
5. Add the chicken wings to the baking sheet in a single layer.
7. While the wings are baking, melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat.
8. Add the flour to the saucepan and whisk together to make a roux.
9. Gradually add the ale mixture from the bowl to the saucepan, whisking constantly.
10. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 5 minutes.
11. After the wings have baked for 30 minutes, increase the oven temperature to 425°F (220°C).
12. Brush the wings with the ale mixture and return to the oven for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until cooked through.
